title: SF25 (2021-2022 Regular): Non-in-person permit to carry renewals authorization

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2021-01-06; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/0/SF/25/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Read the introduced bill (2021-01-06); no vote data in file. The rest of subd. 3 is existing text carried through.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3(e)): Applications for new permits must be submitted in person. Applications for permit renewals may be accepted in person, electronically, or by United States mail, at the sheriff's discretion.
